strings.en: I've got no intention of losing to you!
I can't waste time in a place like this!
Don't come here with half-baked resolve!
Show them your power, Leonysis Harga!
You're in the Leonysis Harga's range!
We're both Leonysis. The basics don't change!
I won't let you get to Rabulpaila!
I've gotta shake those guys off...!
This is what happens when you fail to finish me!
I owe you some thanks for attacking me!
I won't let you go home like this!
I won't fall! I'm the one who wins in the end!
You've done it now! I've had it with you!
Damn it! I'm getting pushed around. Pathetic!
As long as my machine moves, I'll keep fighting!
I can't kick the bucket here!
I-I'm lucky I didn't get shot down...
Damn it! What did you do to my Leonysis!
Show me your true potential, Varga!
I can't die before I find out anything!
Nice work, but it's not a fatal blow!
That just gave me a reason to fire myself up again!
Huh, you're better than I thought.
Interesting! You've got a little backbone!
Ngh, the damage is starting to add up...!
If you think this'll make me flinch, you're dead wrong!
So you bit into the Leonysis Harga!
Sorry, Sally. The Varga got scratched.
If I go down here, I won't be able to do anything!
Don't come at me with half-baked attacks!
A hit's a hit. I'll pay you back properly!
You think that'll shoot me down? Don't make me laugh.
Tch, I didn't dodge in time!
Can't believe I got hit by that...!
Like that's enough to stop my Harga!
Like that could pierce the Varga's armor!
Falling for a basic feint like that!
Attacks like that won't work on the Leonysis Harga!
I can't get shot down here!
Looks like you can't keep up with the Harga!
Your aim wasn't bad, you know?
Ngh, none of my weapons can be used...!
Sally, leave the rest to me!
Captain Vort, leave the rest to me!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Didn't expect me to show up, did you?!
This isn't like you, Captain Vort!
I'll take care of you all at once!
Letting me follow up? Too naive!
Now, let's go out with a bang!
At this distance, it's Short Range Mode!
I'll make this quick and shoot!
I'll finish this in one go!
Bunched up like that, you're a great target!
I'll take you all out at once!
I'll show you the Grungust's finishing move!
Told you it was a finishing move, didn't I?
I'll finish this with one blow...!
If I can just get close...!
This thing's tackle is no joke!
No use running, wherever you go!
Don't think you can read this!
It takes more than that to stop me!
It works just like the Slicer Haken!
Hmph, you're no match for me!
I'll cut you down with this!
That had a nice edge to it.
I'm good at slugging it out!
That's way past cut in two.
I'll hit you with every gun!
I'll show you this thing's trump card!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Hmph, guess I got a little carried away...
I know you're actually a klutz, you know~?
What I have to do is simple!
I'll show you how sharp this is!
I'm staking it all on this!
Ora ora! I won't give you a chance to strike back!!
Can you keep up with this speed?!
Ora ora! You've got nowhere to run!!
With this thing's range and speed!
I can pound in everything I've got!
